'''Gandanta Station''' was a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] located in the [[Phaseera system/Legends|Phaseera system]] of the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]]. An obscure port that was home to thousands, the station was visited by a group of beings who hoped to meet a [[Toydarian]] fence and sell a recently acquired item.<ref name="FH" />
